title: Schrödinger's Cats at The Tiny Venue
body:
Schrödinger's Cats are performing at The Tiny Venue in Town Next To Yours this Saturday at 10:00 PM. Tickets were $15 but the show is sold out.

Why you can't go: Sold out in 0.3 seconds. You didn't even know about it.
summary: Schrödinger's Cats. Sold out in 0.3 seconds. 12 miles away.
